abstract: The policy challenge of balancing economic growth with environmental protection remains a major challenge for oil-dependent economies. Previous studies have extensively examined the nexus between economic growth, energy consumption, and carbon emissions. However, the joint long-run and short-run dynamics of CO 2 emissions and PM 2.5 concentrations in Saudi Arabia have received less attention. This difference is vital because policies intended to reduce greenhouse gases may not achieve comparable improvements in local air quality. This study investigates associations between economic growth, oil-based electricity, non-renewable energy, globalization, and these two environmental indicators in Saudi Arabia using annual data. The ARDL method estimates long-run equilibrium and short-run dynamics, with robustness checked via unit-root, structural-break, bounds, and diagnostic tests. Findings indicate that explanatory variables relate differently to the two environmental indicators. In the long run, emissions are positively associated with globalization, while PM 2.5 concentrations show a positive association with oil-based electricity production. Economic growth is negatively associated with CO 2 emissions but positively associated with PM 2.5 concentrations, suggesting carbon efficiency improvements do not necessarily improve local air quality. The error-correction results confirm stable long-run relationships. These results support integrated environmental policies. Accelerating renewable electricity deployment, improving energy efficiency, promoting cleaner investments, and reducing oil-fired electricity generation can support Saudi Arabia's energy transition while addressing carbon mitigation and air quality.
abstract_zh: 在依赖石油的经济体中，平衡经济增长与环境保护的政策挑战依然是一项重大难题。既有研究已广泛考察经济增长、能源消费与碳排放之间的关系。然而，沙特阿拉伯CO2排放与PM2.5浓度的长期与短期联合动态受到的关注较少。这一差异至关重要，因为旨在减少温室气体的政策未必能在地方空气质量方面取得同等程度的改善。本研究利用年度数据，考察沙特阿拉伯经济增长、基于石油的电力、不可再生能源、全球化与这两项环境指标之间的关联。ARDL方法估计长期均衡与短期动态，并通过单位根检验、结构断点检验、边界检验和诊断检验进行稳健性检验。研究结果表明，解释变量与这两项环境指标的关联方式不同。长期来看，排放与全球化呈正相关，而PM2.5浓度与基于石油的电力生产呈正相关。经济增长与CO2排放呈负相关，但与PM2.5浓度呈正相关，这表明碳效率改善未必能改善地方空气质量。误差修正结果证实了稳定的长期关系。这些结果支持综合性环境政策。加快可再生能源电力部署、提高能源效率、促进更清洁投资以及减少燃油发电，可在应对碳减排与空气质量问题的同时，支持沙特阿拉伯的能源转型。
title: Energy and Economy Dynamics in CO2 Emissions and PM2.5: Evidence From Saudi Arabia
title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯CO2排放与PM2.5中的能源与经济动态

abstract: Energy efficiency is a global priority, but investments in energy efficiency do not always deliver the expected benefits. This paper studies micro-irrigation systems (MIS), a technology thought to reduce the energy required for irrigation by as much as 70 percent. We installed individual meters to directly measure the energy consumption of several hundred farmers in Gujarat, India, and linked the meter data with survey data to yield a uniquely comprehensive view into energy use patterns in smallholder agriculture. We document two facts. One, energy use varies widely across farmers, and this variation is unexplained by factors such as farm area or village geography. Two, MIS users in our sample consume 30 to 40 percent more energy than non-users of MIS. This difference does not appear to be fully explained by observable differences across farmers nor by rebound effects, suggesting that the energy efficiency gains of MIS under real-world conditions may be disappointing. Our results highlight a need for increased attention to the details of implementation and further research into the actual benefits of resource-conserving technologies.
abstract_zh: 能源效率是全球优先事项，但对能源效率的投资并不总能带来预期效益。本文研究微灌系统（MIS），一种被认为可将灌溉所需能源减少多达70%的技术。我们在印度古吉拉特邦为数百名农民安装独立电表，直接测量其能源消耗，并将电表数据与调查数据关联，从而独特而全面地了解小农农业的能源使用模式。我们记录了两个事实。第一，农民之间的能源使用差异很大，而这种差异无法由农场面积或村庄地理等因素解释。第二，在我们的样本中，MIS使用者的能源消耗比非使用者高出30%至40%。这种差异似乎无法完全由农民之间可观察到的差异或反弹效应来解释，这表明MIS在现实条件下的能源效率提升可能令人失望。我们的结果凸显出需要更加关注实施细节，并进一步研究资源节约型技术的实际效益。
title: Does micro-irrigation save energy? An investigation in Gujarat, India
title_zh: 微灌是否节能？印度古吉拉特邦的调查

abstract: This paper investigates the evolving structure of Research and Development (R&D) collaborations in the European hydrogen sector, using data from the Horizon 2020 program to reconstruct a dynamic network of interregional collaboration links. Although green hydrogen is increasingly viewed as a cornerstone of the EU’s decarbonization and energy resilience strategy, innovation capacity in this domain is not uniformly distributed across regions. We adopt a temporal network analysis perspective to uncover the mechanisms that hinder broader regional participation in green hydrogen innovation trajectories. Our analysis reveals an increasing centralization of collaborations around a limited number of regions. These regions attract a growing share of collaborations and progressively consolidate their central positions within the network. This tendency may widen territorial disparities in hydrogen innovation capacity, as the more central regions tend to be those that already have a higher share of green-hydrogen patenting, so that their lead in hydrogen innovation grows over time. Our work highlights the need for network-sensitive R&D policies that mitigate structural polarization in hydrogen collaboration networks. By supporting the inclusion of peripheral regions and promoting diversified partnerships, European policies can turn hydrogen ambitions into an opportunity for more balanced development.
abstract_zh: 本文利用“地平线2020”计划的数据，重建了一个区域间合作联系的动态网络，考察欧洲氢能领域研发合作结构的演变。尽管绿氢日益被视为欧盟脱碳与能源韧性战略的基石，但该领域的创新能力在各区域之间分布并不均衡。我们采用时序网络分析视角，揭示阻碍更广泛区域参与绿氢创新轨迹的机制。我们的分析表明，合作日益向少数区域集中。这些区域吸引了越来越大份额的合作，并逐步巩固其在网络中的中心位置。这一趋势可能扩大氢能创新能力的地域差距，因为处于更中心位置的区域往往也是那些已在绿氢专利方面占据更高份额的区域，从而使其在氢能创新方面的领先地位随时间不断增强。我们的研究凸显了需要采取对网络结构敏感的研发政策，以缓解氢能合作网络中的结构性极化。通过支持边缘区域的参与并促进多元化伙伴关系，欧洲政策可以将氢能雄心转化为实现更均衡发展的机遇。
title: Bridging the hydrogen divide: how network evolution reveals future territorial imbalances in Europe
title_zh: 弥合氢能鸿沟：网络演化如何揭示欧洲未来的区域失衡

abstract: Climate finance aims to support a fair transition to renewable energy in developing countries, yet the conditions under which climate finance is associated with renewable energy development remain unclear. This study examines the relationship between climate finance and renewable energy development using a double machine learning (DML) framework that combines Lasso regression as the base learner with K-fold cross-fitting and Neyman orthogonalization to mitigate potential bias arising from endogeneity and high-dimensional confounding. Drawing on panel data from 71 developing countries over 2000–2019, the DML estimation yields a statistically significant positive association, and the positive association between climate finance and renewable energy development is particularly evident among low-income developing countries. Furthermore, dynamic panel threshold modeling identifies significant threshold values. Specifically, when regulatory quality exceeds −1.060, the association between climate finance and renewable energy development becomes positive; and when trade openness exceeds the threshold value, the positive association between climate finance and renewable energy becomes stronger. Therefore, improving regulatory quality and facilitating trade openness may create more favorable conditions under which climate finance is more strongly associated with renewable energy development.
title: Just transition? Exploring the climate finance, regulatory quality, trade openness and renewable energy nexus
title_zh: 公正转型？探究气候金融、监管质量、贸易开放与可再生能源之间的关系

abstract: This paper examines whether concentration in electricity generation affects the deployment of wind and solar capacity across the 27 European Union member states over 2000–2022. Market concentration is measured by the generation share of the largest electricity producer, and wind and solar deployment is measured as installed wind and solar capacity relative to total national electricity capacity. Using a country-level panel and dynamic estimation methods that account for persistence, unobserved heterogeneity, and reverse causality—including fixed-effects OLS and Arellano–Bond GMM estimators with lagged concentration as an internal instrument—the analysis finds no systematic relationship between market concentration and subsequent wind or solar deployment. The result is robust across alternative concentration and outcome measures, bias-corrected dynamic panel estimators, balanced samples, region-specific linear time trends and heterogeneity analyses across regions, transition stages, energy-system characteristics, and policy regimes. The findings suggest that within the EU institutional setting, market concentration per se is not a first-order constraint on renewable uptake; instead, deployment is primarily driven by policy settings and the path dependence inherent in installed capacity.
title: Electricity market structure and consequences for wind and solar uptake in the EU-27
title_zh: 欧盟27国电力市场结构及其对风能和太阳能采用的影响

abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the dual-credit policy on automakers' production and research and development (R&D) strategies by developing an optimization model for the production and R&D decisions of automakers regarding electric vehicles (EVs) and fuel vehicles (FVs). It yields several key findings. First, when R&D costs for EVs and FVs are low, an increase in the credit percentage requirement (CPR) induces automakers to transition from producing only FVs to producing both FVs and EVs, achieving partial electrification. Subsequently, automakers shift to exclusively producing EVs, realizing full electrification. In contrast, automakers attain full electrification directly by transitioning from the production of FVs to EVs. Second, when producing both FVs and EVs, an increase in CPR drives automakers' R&D focus from FVs to both vehicle types and ultimately to EVs. Finally, as consumers' purchase preferences shift from FVs to EVs, electrification and R&D strategies of automakers may undergo significant changes.
title: Automakers' electrification and R&D strategies under the dual-credit policy
title_zh: 双积分政策下汽车制造商的电动化与研发策略

abstract: Maritime transport, responsible for roughly 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions, faces overlapping carbon-pricing regulation as the EU Emissions Trading System extends to shipping and the International Maritime Organization develops a prospective Net-Zero Framework with tradeable Remedial Units. This raises a central question: whether instrument interaction, rather than the stringency of any one measure, changes firm-level investment when carbon prices are held fixed, and how it shapes investment policy and the value of flexibility under uncertainty. We develop a correlated three-factor real-options framework using Longstaff–Schwartz continuation-value estimation with independent validation and test-sample policy evaluation, jointly modelling freight, fuel and carbon prices with calibrated cross-correlations and a Poisson hazard model for regulatory activation. We apply it to a Long Range 2 product tanker across four regimes: EU ETS phase-in, sustained regional fragmentation, and EU ETS plus IMO under netted or stacked interaction rules. Three findings emerge. First, regulatory architecture is economically material: netted versus stacked rules shift strategy NPVs by approximately $1 million at unchanged carbon prices. Second, the efficiency-first ranking is preserved across all regimes, including fragmentation where effective carbon exposure nearly doubles. Third, direct fuel-price support of about $200–300 per tonne substantially improves staged alternative-fuel pathways but does not eliminate the structural advantage of low-CAPEX efficiency retrofits, indicating that per-tonne support narrows but does not close the remaining economic gap. Results are robust across sixteen sensitivity dimensions and Capesize and feeder cross-segment checks.
title: Regulatory architecture and shipowner investment response under overlapping carbon-pricing regimes
title_zh: 重叠碳定价机制下的监管架构与船东投资响应

abstract: While all children in Sweden are entitled to free, universal preschool from age 3, enrollment rates for children with an immigrant background – and especially for those in newly-arrived families – remain well below the 95 percent national average. At the same time, studies suggest that these children have particularly high returns from preschool attendance. Thus, policies that increase preschool enrollment among children with an immigrant background have potential to improve long-term educational and labor market outcomes and narrow the gap to natives. We evaluate a reform in 2023 that required municipalities to offer reserved preschool slots to 3–5-year-olds in newly-arrived immigrant families without the parents needing to apply – so-called automatic offers. Using a difference-in-differences specification, we compare next-year enrollment rates for currently non-enrolled children in newly-arrived families and other families and find that the policy substantially increased preschool enrollment. Our results suggest that administrative hurdles prevent some immigrant families from enrolling their children and that simplifying the application process is an effective policy tool for increasing preschool participation in this group.
title: Reforming the preschool application system to reduce enrollment gaps evidence from a default enrollment policy
title_zh: 改革学前教育申请系统以缩小入学差距：来自默认入学政策的证据

abstract: Both analytical general-equilibrium models and applied applications generally make compromises to avoid endogenous zeros and discrete regime shifts. In open economy models, assumptions such as national-level product differentiation, a continuum of firms, probabilistic production, and smooth parametric distribution functions ensure interior, closed-form solutions to systems of equations. But resulting complexities restrict models to sparse general-equilibrium structures. I offer an alternative by exploiting non-linear complementarity. While this approach is applicable to many problems where boundary solutions are important, I focus on heterogeneous firms, endogenous exporting and multinational production. There is a discrete set of firm types allowing for any differences in productivity which can be calibrated from observed market shares. The model incorporates large firms with endogenous markups and solves for the set of active firms and their supply modes (no entry, domestic, exporting, multinational). Although focusing on international trade, I argue that the complementarity formulation is valuable for a wide range of economic equilibrium problems, allowing empirically-relevant policy analysis.
title: Exploiting complementarity in applied general-equilibrium models
title_zh: 利用应用一般均衡模型中的互补性

abstract: Recent NCAA policy changes reduced barriers to player mobility and allowed athletes to be compensated for their Name, Image, and Likeness, making the labour market for athletes more competitive. We investigate how these changes affect the distribution of elite quarterback talent within NCAA football. After controlling for the supply of elite quarterbacks, which increases during the NIL period, and team-specific factors, we find no aggregate effect on the likelihood of teams having an elite quarterback on their roster. However, Power conference schools do have significantly more elite quarterbacks on their rosters after the policy change, and this is primarily driven by elite talent moving to schools without a returning starting quarterback. This suggests that these policy changes allow market forces to direct resources where they have an opportunity to be more productive. These findings suggest that market forces are directing elite quarterbacks towards Power programmes where there is a chance to start, and QB talent generally is moving to where it has a clearer path towards playing time. KEYWORDS: NIL football labour mobility sports economics JEL CLASSIFICATION: J08 Z28 J62
abstract_zh: 近期NCAA政策调整降低了球员流动壁垒，并允许运动员就其姓名、形象和肖像权获得补偿，这使得运动员劳动力市场更具竞争性。我们研究了这些变化如何影响NCAA橄榄球中精英四分卫人才的分布。在控制了精英四分卫供给（在NIL时期有所增加）以及球队特定因素后，我们发现这些变化对球队阵容中拥有精英四分卫的可能性没有总体效应。然而，政策变化后，权力联盟学校阵容中的精英四分卫数量显著增加，这主要源于精英人才流向那些没有回归首发四分卫的学校。这表明，这些政策调整使市场力量能够将资源引导至其可能更具生产力的地方。这些发现表明，市场力量正将精英四分卫引向有机会首发的权力联盟项目，而四分卫人才总体上正流向那些上场时间路径更清晰的学校。关键词：NIL 橄榄球 劳动力流动性 体育经济学 JEL分类：J08 Z28 J62
title: NIL, the transfer portal, and quarterback talent in NCAA football
title_zh: NCAA橄榄球中的NIL、转会门户与四分卫人才

abstract: Inter-regional investment plays a critical role in enabling capital flows and fostering coordinated regional development. Drawing on the micro-level behaviour of establishing inter-regional subsidiaries, this study examines the impact of enterprise digital transformation on inter-regional investment using data on Chinese A-share listed companies from 2011 to 2023. Results show that enterprise digital transformation significantly facilitates inter-regional investment. The primary mechanisms involve increasing the level of specialized division of labour, enhancing information transparency, and improving operational performance. The facilitative impact is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, industries with high competition, and regions with well-developed factor markets. Further analysis reveals an inverted U-shaped distance pattern in this effect. Digital transformation encourages investment towards peripheral and border cities, although core and non-border destinations benefit more. Moreover, inter-regional expansion under digital transformation contributes to a smaller inter-city economic development gap. Through micro-level empirical evidence, this study highlights the digital dividends of enterprise digital transformation across regional boundaries, offering strategic insights for enterprises navigating digital transformation and optimizing investment decisions, while informing government efforts to promote coordinated and sustainable development. KEYWORDS: Digital transformation inter-regional investment specialized division of labor information transparency operational performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 G34 R11
abstract_zh: 跨区域投资在促进资本流动和推动区域协调发展方面发挥着关键作用。本研究基于设立跨区域子公司的微观行为视角，利用2011年至2023年中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了企业数字化转型对跨区域投资的影响。结果表明，企业数字化转型显著促进了跨区域投资。其主要机制在于提升专业化分工水平、增强信息透明度以及改善经营绩效。这一促进作用在非国有企业、竞争激烈的行业以及要素市场发达的地区中更为显著。进一步分析显示，该效应呈现倒U型的距离模式。数字化转型推动投资向边缘城市和边境城市延伸，但核心城市和非边境目的地受益更多。此外，数字化转型下的跨区域扩张有助于缩小城市间的经济发展差距。本研究通过微观层面的实证证据，揭示了企业数字化转型跨越区域边界的数字红利，为企业推进数字化转型和优化投资决策提供了战略参考，同时为政府促进协调可持续发展提供了政策启示。关键词：数字化转型；跨区域投资；专业化分工；信息透明度；经营绩效 JEL分类：O33 G34 R11
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用中国A股上市公司数据，研究对象为中国企业，核心应用涉及中国区域投资，明确属于中国研究。
title: Digital dividends across boundaries: inter-regional investment under enterprise digital transformation
title_zh: 跨边界数字红利：企业数字化转型下的区域间投资

abstract: How does population aging affect the political decision-making regarding the inflation target? Using an overlapping generations New Keynesian model, we analyze how demographic factors affect the inflation target rates preferred by young and old households, respectively. Given a demographic structure, the earnings redistribution channel leads young and old households to have different preferences over the inflation target: the optimal target rate for the average old household is negative, whereas that for the average young household is close to zero. Hence, the composition effect of population aging on the population-weighted average of these optimal rates is negative. However, the overall effect is either positive or only marginally negative, depending on whether the transition to a new steady state is taken into account, and there is no strong negative association between the population-weighted average of the optimal inflation rates and population aging. The analysis reveals that greater longevity and lower birth rates make the preferences of young and old households more similar, either directly through utility functions or indirectly through a lower real interest rate.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化如何影响关于通胀目标的政治决策？通过运用世代交叠的新凯恩斯模型，我们分析了人口因素如何分别影响年轻与老年家庭所偏好的通胀目标率。在给定的人口结构下，收入再分配渠道导致年轻与老年家庭对通胀目标持有不同偏好：平均老年家庭的最优目标率为负，而平均年轻家庭的最优目标率接近于零。因此，人口老龄化对人口加权平均最优目标率的构成效应为负。然而，总体效应要么为正，要么仅为轻微负值，这取决于是否考虑向新稳态的过渡，且人口加权平均最优通胀率与人口老龄化之间并无强烈的负相关关系。分析揭示，寿命延长和出生率降低使得年轻与老年家庭的偏好趋于一致，这种趋同或直接通过效用函数实现，或间接通过较低的实际利率实现。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Generational War on Inflation? Optimal Inflation Rates for the Young and the Old
title_zh: 代际通胀之争？年轻人与老年人的最优通胀率

abstract: If individuals’ prosocial motivations are complements, this creates an important lever for the provision of social capital. We develop a framework to identify motivation complementarities and apply it in the context of voluntary blood donations—a key example of a purely prosocial behavior. Using quasi-random phone calls to identify causal effects, we find that a 10 percentage point increase in the donation rate for a blood drive raises a focal donor’s turnout by about 5.6 percentage points, creating a policy multiplier of 2.3. We also rule out lower costs from joint traveling as the main driver of the motivation complementarities. Rather, they result, at least partly, from more general mechanisms, such as utility from social approval, peer pressure, or social image concerns.
abstract_zh: 如果个体的亲社会动机具有互补性，这将为社会资本的供给提供一个重要的杠杆。我们构建了一个框架来识别动机互补性，并将其应用于自愿献血情境——这是纯粹亲社会行为的一个关键例子。利用准随机电话呼叫来识别因果效应，我们发现，献血活动中献血率每提高10个百分点，会使焦点捐赠者的参与率上升约5.6个百分点，从而产生2.3的政策乘数效应。我们还排除了共同出行降低成本作为动机互补性主要驱动因素的可能性。相反，这些互补性至少部分源于更普遍的机制，如社会认可带来的效用、同伴压力或社会形象关注。
title: Motivation Complementarities in Prosocial Behavior: Evidence from Social Networks of Blood Donors
title_zh: 亲社会行为中的动机互补性：来自献血者社交网络的证据

abstract: This paper examines the structural ties between federally recognized programmatic accreditors and their affiliated professional and trade associations, arguing that these organizational arrangements constitute conflicts of interest that compromise the quality-assurance function accreditation is intended to serve. Drawing on a novel dataset constructed from IRS Form 990 XML filings for 25 accreditor-association pairs over a seven-year panel (2017–2023), we develop and operationalize a three-part typology of capture mechanisms: structural subordination, financial entanglement, and governance overlap. We construct a Regulatory Capture Index (RCI) to measure the intensity of structural capture across the sample. Twenty-two of the 25 pairs are joined by a shared employer identification number, a consolidated filing, or a single legal identity, leaving three structurally separate accreditors; all fourteen licensure-gated health professions pairs score at the maximum RCI of 1.0. Scores are bimodal and static, with no pair occupying an intermediate position and none altering its organizational form across the panel. Because shared legal identity leaves no arm’s-length financial or governance record, separation is observationally indistinguishable from complete entanglement for 88 percent of the sample, suggesting that the arrangements that most compromise independence are precisely those that generate the least evidence of it.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了联邦认可的纲领性认证机构与其附属专业和行业协会之间的结构性联系，认为这些组织安排构成了利益冲突，损害了认证本应发挥的质量保障功能。基于从美国国税局990表格XML申报文件中构建的新数据集，涵盖2017至2023年七年面板中25对认证机构与协会组合，我们开发并操作化了一个由三部分组成的俘获机制类型学：结构性从属、财务纠缠和治理重叠。我们构建了监管俘获指数（RCI）以衡量样本中结构性俘获的强度。25对中有22对通过共享雇主识别号、合并申报或单一法律身份相连，仅剩三个结构上独立的认证机构；所有十四个涉及执照准入的健康职业组合均达到RCI最大值1.0。得分呈双峰分布且保持静态，没有一对处于中间位置，也没有任何一对在面板期间改变其组织形式。由于共享法律身份不留下任何保持距离的财务或治理记录，对于88%的样本而言，分离在观测上与完全纠缠无法区分，这表明最损害独立性的安排恰恰是那些产生最少独立性证据的安排。
title: Captured Gatekeepers: Structural Conflicts of Interest in U.S. Higher Education Accreditation
title_zh: 被俘获的守门人：美国高等教育认证中的结构性利益冲突

abstract: I study how economic expectation shocks induced by elections contribute to democratic discontent in polarized societies, focusing on the 2022 Brazilian presidential election. Using newly collected survey data, I investigate how respondents’ expectations and attitudes toward democracy evolved after the opposition candidate’s narrow victory. By resurveying respondents post-election, I show that losing polarized voters who overestimate their candidate’s chances of winning experience a large negative economic expectation shock, as well as an increase in their anti-democratic sentiment. In an additional survey experiment, I provide causal evidence that this shock is a driver of democratic discontent, by showing that positively updating respondents’ economic expectations reduces their anti-democratic sentiment.
abstract_zh: 我研究了选举引发的经济预期冲击如何在极化社会中加剧民主不满，并以2022年巴西总统选举为焦点。利用新收集的调查数据，我探讨了在反对派候选人以微弱优势获胜后，受访者的经济预期及对民主的态度如何演变。通过对受访者进行选举后再次调查，我发现，那些高估其候选人获胜概率的落败方极化选民，经历了显著负面的经济预期冲击，同时其反民主情绪也有所上升。在一项额外的调查实验中，我提供了因果证据，表明这种冲击是民主不满的一个驱动因素，具体表现为，正向更新受访者的经济预期可降低其反民主情绪。
title: Election results and democratic discontent: Expectations, extremism, and democratic values in post-election Brazil
title_zh: 选举结果与民主不满：巴西大选后的期望、极端主义与民主价值观

abstract: The classic literature argues that a large middle class is a prerequisite for economic development. Is this true when AI progress threatens to disrupt the labor market? On the one hand, uncertainty about the consequences can impede the passage of AI-friendly regulation: voters fear the prospect of losing when the uncertainty is resolved. On the other, granular information about reform consequences may reduce political support as well. In our model, a larger middle class hampers reform, compensatory redistribution is most politically effective when its welfare justification is weakest, and AI regulatory sandboxes encounter resistance because new information undermines reform coalitions.
abstract_zh: 经典文献认为，庞大的中产阶级是经济发展的先决条件。当人工智能的进步可能扰乱劳动力市场时，这一论断是否依然成立？一方面，对后果的不确定性可能阻碍有利于人工智能的法规通过：选民担心不确定性解决时自己会面临损失。另一方面，关于改革后果的详细信息也可能削弱政治支持。在我们的模型中，中产阶级规模越大反而阻碍改革，补偿性再分配在其福利正当性最弱时最具政治效力，而人工智能监管沙盒之所以遭遇阻力，是因为新信息破坏了改革联盟。
title: When the Middle Class Undermines Progress: The Political Economy of AI Regulation
title_zh: 当中产阶级削弱进步：人工智能监管的政治经济学

abstract: This study examines the impact of payroll-tax enforcement on firm dynamism and its implications for aggregate productivity. We exploit China’s Social Security Collection Agency Reform, which transferred responsibility for collecting social-insurance contributions from local social-insurance agencies to tax authorities, thereby strengthening enforcement. We show that the reform increased firms’ social-insurance contributions, shifted workers toward informal employment without reducing overall nonagricultural employment, and reduced new firm entry while weakening incumbent firms’ profitability and investment. Overall, the reform reduced measured aggregate productivity in China’s registered, above-scale industrial sector by 3.3 percent, with entry into the above-scale industrial sector accounting for about 45 percent of the estimated decline.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了工资税征管对企业活力及其对总体生产率的影响。我们利用中国社会保险征缴机构改革，该改革将社会保险缴费的征收职责从地方社会保险机构转移至税务部门，从而加强了征管力度。研究表明，该改革增加了企业的社会保险缴费，促使劳动力转向非正规就业而未减少总体非农就业，同时降低了新企业进入率，并削弱了现有企业的盈利能力和投资。总体而言，该改革使中国登记注册的规模以上工业部门的测算总体生产率下降了3.3%，其中进入规模以上工业部门对估计下降的贡献约占45%。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Payroll taxes, firm dynamism, and aggregate productivity
title_zh: 工资税、企业活力与总体生产率

abstract: Weather-induced agricultural shocks are geographically selective, as exposure reflects both exogenous atmospheric dynamics and predetermined local geography. We exploit the knowledge of shock determinants to isolate the exogenous component, relying on counterfactual simulations to measure medium-term farmers’ adaptation strategies. Using microdata from Ethiopia and an outbreak of desert locust swarms as source of the shock, we find a shift in agricultural production composition and an increase in household farm labour to smooth consumption. A producer–consumer approach reveals the farmers’ response not to be productivity-neutral in the medium-term, while individual factors’ intensity is used to offset a decrease in partial productivity. Estimating a Cobb–Douglas production function, we find a drop in total factor productivity in treated areas, a decline that exceeds the reduced-form output loss and indicates that available adaptive responses preserve subsistence output while carrying substantial productivity costs.
abstract_zh: 天气引发的农业冲击在地理上具有选择性，因为暴露程度既反映了外生的大气动态，也反映了既定的地方地理特征。我们利用对冲击决定因素的认知来分离外生成分，并依赖反事实模拟来衡量农民的中期适应策略。利用埃塞俄比亚的微观数据以及沙漠蝗虫群爆发作为冲击来源，我们发现农业生产结构发生转变，家庭农业劳动力增加以平滑消费。生产者—消费者方法揭示，农民的反应在中期并非生产力中性的，而个体因素的强度被用来抵消部分生产力的下降。通过估计柯布—道格拉斯生产函数，我们发现处理地区全要素生产率下降，这一降幅超过了简化形式产出损失，表明可用的适应性响应在维持生存产出的同时，承担了显著的生产力成本。
title: Gone with the wind: Productive response to agricultural shock
title_zh: 随风而逝：农业冲击的生产性应对

abstract: We characterize the optimal contract within the class of fixed-terms mechanisms in a repeated buyer-seller relationship with persistent adverse selection and one-sided limited enforcement. The seller reports his type once, and the corresponding transfer and output are then repeated in every period. After receiving the current transfer, the seller may breach, pay an enforceable penalty, and terminate the relationship. In this benchmark, the enforcement problem collapses to a bound on the transfer targeted to the most efficient type. This yields a three-regime characterization. With strong enforcement, the repeated static second-best contract is feasible. With weak (intermediate) enforcement, the top transfer is capped, inducing bunching among efficient types and additional downward distortions. With very weak enforcement, sustaining compliance through public penalties alone would require excessive quantity distortions, and the optimal contract instead leaves strictly positive continuation rents, including for the least efficient type. We interpret the associated distortion as a virtual enforcement cost.
abstract_zh: 我们在重复买卖双方关系中，针对固定期限机制类别，刻画了最优契约，该关系具有持久性逆向选择与单边有限执行的特点。卖方仅报告一次其类型，相应的转移支付与产出随后在每一期重复。在收到当期转移支付后，卖方可能违约，支付可执行的罚金，并终止关系。在此基准情形下，执行问题简化为对最有效率类型所对应转移支付的上限约束。这产生了三区域特征描述。在强执行下，重复的静态次优契约是可行的。在弱（中等）执行下，最高转移支付受到上限限制，导致有效率类型之间的聚集以及额外的向下扭曲。在极弱执行下，仅通过公共罚金维持合规将要求过度的数量扭曲，而最优契约则转而留下严格正的持续租金，包括对最无效率类型也是如此。我们将相关扭曲解释为一种虚拟执行成本。
title: Optimal fixed-terms contracts under one-sided enforcement and persistent adverse selection
title_zh: 单向执行与持续逆向选择下的最优固定期限合同

abstract: The allocation of decision rights—and the decision hierarchies it creates—shape incentives in organizations and thus individual motivation. We study whether the motivational effects of decision hierarchies go beyond pecuniary incentives and how they relate to the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. In a laboratory experiment, we exogenously manipulate the payoff structure of an organization in a way that leaves the pecuniary incentives of all involved parties unaffected but shifts subordinates’ perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. Our data show that subordinates’ motivation to provide effort is causally affected by the organizational payoff structure, and significantly associated with the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy.
abstract_zh: 决策权的分配——以及由此产生的决策层级——塑造了组织中的激励机制，进而影响个体的动机。我们研究决策层级的激励效应是否超越金钱激励，以及这些效应如何与决策层级的感知合法性相关联。在一项实验室实验中，我们外生地操纵组织的报酬结构，使得所有相关方的金钱激励保持不变，但改变了下属对决策层级感知合法性的态度。数据显示，下属提供努力的动机受到组织报酬结构的因果影响，并与决策层级的感知合法性显著相关。
title: Legitimate Decision Authority and Motivation in Organizations
title_zh: 组织中的合法决策权威与动机

abstract: We develop a symmetrized smooth test for the equality of two distributions by incorporating information from two probability integral transform representations in a symmetric manner. This construction eliminates the dependence on the assignment of roles to the two samples. We establish the asymptotic Chi-square null distribution of the proposed symmetrized statistic and characterize its behavior under fixed and local alternatives. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed test achieves more stable size control and improved finite-sample performance, particularly when the sample sizes are small or unbalanced.
abstract_zh: 我们通过对称地整合两种概率积分变换表示的信息，开发了一种用于检验两个分布相等性的对称化平滑检验。这一构造消除了对两个样本角色分配依赖的问题。我们确立了所提出的对称化统计量的渐近卡方零分布，并刻画了其在固定备择和局部备择下的行为。模拟研究表明，所提出的检验在样本量较小或不平衡时，实现了更稳定的尺寸控制和改进的有限样本性能。
title: Symmetrized smooth test for the equality of distributions
title_zh: 对称化平滑检验用于分布相等性

abstract: Holding score fixed, unit-price bidders can reallocate line-item prices to hedge quantity risk. Repricing governs how this hedge affects realized payment, while a bid screen limits its size. Their interaction leaves residual exposure: baseline exposure minus effective hedge capacity, truncated at zero. Under constant absolute risk aversion (CARA), residual exposure generates a certainty-equivalent premium in the first-price score equilibrium. With a fixed binding screen, stronger repricing raises expected procurement payments when lost hedge capacity exceeds direct exposure relief. Calibrating the screen to preserve residual exposure preserves allocation, bidder utility, and expected payment under mean-level normalization.
abstract_zh: 在保持评分不变的情况下，按单价投标的竞标者可以重新分配各分项价格以对冲数量风险。重新定价决定了这种对冲如何影响实际支付，而投标筛选则限制了其规模。两者相互作用产生了剩余风险敞口：即基准风险敞口减去有效对冲能力，并以零为下限截断。在常数绝对风险厌恶（CARA）假设下，剩余风险敞口在第一价格评分均衡中产生确定性等价溢价。当固定且具有约束力的筛选存在时，若失去的对冲能力超过直接风险敞口缓解，更强的重新定价会提高预期采购支付。将筛选校准以保持剩余风险敞口不变，在均值水平归一化下，可保持配置、竞标者效用及预期支付不变。
title: Calibrating bid screens under quantity repricing
title_zh: 数量重定价下投标屏幕的校准

abstract: Many decisions are taken jointly by multiple individuals. When outcomes are uncertain, decision-makers may have different subjective expectations (“beliefs”) about the consequences of different choices. We develop a tractable empirical framework for identifying the relative influence of joint decision-makers’ beliefs without assuming Pareto optimality when beliefs differ. We apply the framework to contraceptive choices in Nigeria, examining the relative weight couples place on wives’ versus husbands’ beliefs. We find that spouses have different subjective expectations, and that the weight placed on each spouse’s beliefs varies across domains. Therefore, the optimal targeting of information interventions to husbands or wives is domain-dependent.
abstract_zh: 许多决策由多人共同作出。当结果不确定时，决策者可能对不同选择的后果持有不同的主观预期（“信念”）。我们开发了一个易于处理的实证框架，用于识别联合决策者信念的相对影响力，无需在信念差异时假设帕累托最优。我们将该框架应用于尼日利亚的避孕选择，考察夫妻对妻子与丈夫信念的相对权重。我们发现配偶双方持有不同的主观预期，且对每位配偶信念的权重在不同领域间有所变化。因此，信息干预措施针对丈夫或妻子的最优定向取决于具体领域。
title: Subjective Expectations of Husbands and Wives and Couples’ Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
title_zh: 丈夫与妻子的主观预期及不确定性下的夫妻决策

abstract: We show that the optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions depend on the commodity cycle. Stabilizing domestic prices is optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But when economies import commodities as production inputs, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ their direct and indirect effects on domestic prices. In emerging economies, where financial conditions are closely related to commodity cycles, trade-offs are starker and limited credibility may make implementing optimal policy challenging.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优的货币与汇率框架在很大程度上取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活但易于处理的经济模型，包含商品出口与进口，其中国际金融状况随商品周期而变化。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议相符。但当经济体将商品作为生产投入品进口时，最优政策在很大程度上“透视”其对国内价格的直接与间接影响。在新兴经济体中，金融状况与商品周期紧密相关，权衡更为严峻，而有限的信誉可能使实施最优政策面临挑战。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究大宗商品暴露经济体的货币与汇率框架，属一般性开放经济理论，未以中国为研究对象或数据背景。
title: Optimal monetary and exchange rate frameworks for commodity-exposed economies
title_zh: 大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架

abstract: Why is war so economically costly? Our answer is that modern war lowers output not only by destroying productive factors, but also by making the surviving economy work less efficiently. Using uniquely comprehensive firm-level data collected during Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, we document a dramatic collapse in allocative productivity in Ukraine. To sharpen identification and explore key mechanisms (including the role of war intensity, internal displacement, reallocation, and macroeconomic instability), we exploit spatial heterogeneity across Ukrainian districts and comparisons with Russian aggression in 2014 and the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. Our key policy implication is that restoring allocative efficiency--and preparing institutional arrangements that facilitate rapid reallocation in times of stress--is critical for sustaining economic capacity, defense, and national security.
abstract_zh: 为何战争的经济代价如此高昂？我们的答案是，现代战争不仅通过摧毁生产要素来降低产出，还使幸存经济体的运作效率下降。利用2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间收集的独特且全面的企业层面数据，我们记录了乌克兰配置生产率的大幅崩溃。为了强化识别并探索关键机制（包括战争强度、国内流离失所、重新配置及宏观经济不稳定的作用），我们利用了乌克兰各地区间的空间异质性，并与2014年俄罗斯侵略及2008年全球金融危机进行了比较。我们的核心政策启示是，恢复配置效率——并准备好在压力时期促进快速重新配置的制度安排——对于维持经济能力、国防和国家安全至关重要。
title: The Allocative Cost of War: A View to a Kill…ing of Productivity
title_zh: 战争的配置成本：生产率之殇的视角

abstract: The US government’s demand for bank deposits is large and volatile and takes the form of the Treasury General Account (TGA) at the Federal Reserve. I study drivers of TGA volatility and how the Federal Reserve should adjust its balance sheet in response to this volatility. Using interest rate control, control of the Fed’s overall policy stance, and communication as criteria, an approach of backing the TGA with Treasury bills (or other short-maturity assets) and adjusting bill holdings with TGA fluctuations outperforms the current ample reserves policy of letting reserves plus overnight reverse repo balances adjust passively to TGA changes.
abstract_zh: 美国政府对于银行存款的需求规模庞大且波动剧烈，其表现形式为美联储的财政部总账户（TGA）。我研究了TGA波动的驱动因素，以及美联储应如何调整其资产负债表以应对这种波动。以利率控制、美联储整体政策立场的掌控以及沟通作为标准，采用以国库券（或其他短期资产）支持TGA，并根据TGA波动调整国库券持有量的方法，优于当前允许准备金加隔夜逆回购余额被动适应TGA变化的充足准备金政策。
title: Fluctuations in the Treasury General Account and their effect on the Fed’s balance sheet
title_zh: 财政部一般账户的波动及其对美联储资产负债表的影响

abstract: Indigenous crops remain visible within the markets and cultivation spaces of many African cities, yet their institutional positioning within urban food systems remains under-examined. While frequently recognised for their nutritional, ecological, and socio-cultural value, little is known about how these crops are currently embedded within urban governance structures. This paper investigates how indigenous crops are integrated into Accra’s urban food system and why they remain structurally marginal within urban food governance frameworks. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with farmers, market actors, agricultural officials, researchers, municipal authorities, and land-use planning actors, we adopt a multi-actor qualitative approach to examine the governance conditions shaping indigenous crop production, circulation and support. The findings show that indigenous crops persist in Accra largely through informal retail networks, direct farmer–buyer relations, and small-scale cultivation in improvised urban spaces. Their presence in markets and cultivation sites does not, however, translate into coordinated institutional support. Farmers grow selected indigenous crops where demand is reliable, while crops perceived as less profitable, harder to prepare, or less compatible with changing urban consumption practices receive weaker market support. Agricultural institutions acknowledge indigenous crops, yet municipal planning and land governance systems rarely incorporate them explicitly into policy frameworks, resulting in institutional diffusion rather than coordinated support. The analysis conceptualises this condition as fragmented urban food governance – a situation in which responsibilities for food production, land-use planning, and market development operate in parallel but without deliberate alignment. Indigenous crops thus persist through informal practices and local initiative, yet remain peripheral within formal governance structures. By showing how indigenous crops are sustained through informality but remain weakly embedded in coordinated policy and planning systems, the paper contributes to debates on policy integration and guides on how to improve the resilience of urban food system transformation in rapidly urbanising African contexts.
abstract_zh: 本土作物在许多非洲城市的市场和种植空间中依然可见，但其在城市食品系统中的制度定位仍未得到充分研究。尽管这些作物因其营养、生态和社会文化价值而常获认可，但关于它们当前如何嵌入城市治理结构的知识却十分有限。本文探讨了本土作物如何融入阿克拉的城市食品系统，以及为何它们在城市食品治理框架中仍处于结构性边缘地位。基于对农民、市场参与者、农业官员、研究人员、市政当局和土地利用规划行动者的35次半结构化访谈，我们采用多行动者定性方法，考察了影响本土作物生产、流通和支持的治理条件。研究结果表明，阿克拉的本土作物主要通过非正规零售网络、农民与买家直接关系以及临时城市空间中的小规模种植得以存续。然而，它们在市场和种植场所的存在并未转化为协调的制度支持。农民在需求可靠的条件下种植选定的本土作物，而被认为利润较低、制备更困难或与不断变化的城市消费习惯兼容性较差的作物则获得较弱的市场支持。农业机构承认本土作物，但市政规划和土地治理系统很少将其明确纳入政策框架，导致制度分散而非协调支持。分析将此状况概念化为碎片化的城市食品治理——即食品生产、土地利用规划和市场发展的责任并行运作，却缺乏有意的协调一致。因此，本土作物通过非正规实践和地方主动性得以存续，但在正式治理结构中仍处于边缘地位。通过展示本土作物如何依赖非正规性得以维持，却未能深度嵌入协调的政策和规划系统，本文为政策整合的讨论作出贡献，并为在快速城市化的非洲背景下提升城市食品系统转型的韧性提供指导。
title: Fragmented urban food governance and impacts on the marginalisation of indigenous crops in Ghana
title_zh: 碎片化的城市食品治理及其对加纳本土作物边缘化的影响

abstract: The Turkish central bank cut interest rates over 2021-2023, on the politically driven view that higher rates cause inflation. This column analyses the policies used instead: foreign exchange interventions, a foreign-exchange-protected deposit scheme, and eventually financial repression and soft capital controls. These interventions did not remove currency risk but moved it onto the government, widened sovereign spreads, and converted a monetary problem into a fiscal one. After the 2023 elections, orthodox policy returned. However, the costs of this experiment are large and still being paid, making the eventual adjustment larger than the one avoided.
abstract_zh: 土耳其中央银行在2021年至2023年间下调利率，其背后是受政治驱动的观点，认为高利率会导致通胀。本文分析了替代政策的使用：外汇干预、外汇保护存款计划，以及最终的金融抑制和温和资本管制。这些干预措施并未消除货币风险，而是将其转移至政府，扩大了主权利差，并将货币问题转化为财政问题。2023年选举后，正统政策回归。然而，这一实验的成本巨大且仍在支付中，使得最终的调整规模大于所避免的调整。
title: Financial engineering is no substitute for interest rates: Lessons from Türkiye
title_zh: 金融工程无法替代利率：来自土耳其的教训

abstract: Critical minerals for the energy transition are triggering new development challenges. This article contributes to understanding these challenges by discussing the emergence of socio-technical imaginaries regarding the prospects of lithium extraction in Puno, Peru. Some scholars explain how state policies in Chile, Argentina, and Bolivia rely on state officials’ lithium imaginaries related to ideas of technological development, industrialization, and sustainability. Others have delved into how the grassroots question dominant lithium imaginaries and policies. Nonetheless, between the forging of dominant imaginaries and local contestation, there are more complex forms of co-existence of imaginaries and negotiation of ontological differences. Considering the relevance of addressing this complexity, this article presents a multi-site analysis to discuss how different actors from the state, civil society, the corporate sector, and local communities appeal to similar discourses but formulate different imaginaries on lithium extraction. Based on semi-structured interviews, documentary analysis, and participatory research, this article categorizes these imaginaries in a market-led sociotechnical imaginary, mostly advanced by high state officials and corporate actors; a state-led sociotechnical imaginary, differently advanced by sub-national authorities and regional organizations; and a commodity imaginary, advanced by local leaders and communities in their pursuit to overcome poverty and exclusion. While these imaginaries overlap in a new extractive frontier, local communities do not renounce their ontological world, connected to traditional economies and livelihoods.
abstract_zh: 能源转型所需的关键矿产正引发新的发展挑战。本文通过探讨秘鲁普诺地区锂矿开采前景的社会技术想象之兴起，为理解这些挑战作出贡献。部分学者阐释了智利、阿根廷和玻利维亚的国家政策如何依赖于国家官员关于技术发展、工业化和可持续性理念的锂矿想象。另一些学者则深入探讨了基层民众如何质疑主导性的锂矿想象与政策。然而，在主导性想象的形成与地方抗争之间，存在着更为复杂的想象共存形式及本体论差异的协商过程。鉴于处理这种复杂性的重要性，本文采用多点位分析，探讨国家、公民社会、企业部门和地方社区中的不同行动者如何援引相似的话语，却对锂矿开采形成不同的想象。基于半结构化访谈、文献分析和参与式研究，本文将上述想象归类为：市场主导的社会技术想象，主要由高层国家官员和企业行动者推进；国家主导的社会技术想象，由次国家级当局和区域组织以不同方式推进；以及商品想象，由地方领袖和社区在摆脱贫困与排斥的追求中提出。尽管这些想象在新的采掘前沿相互重叠，地方社区并未放弃其与传统文化经济和生计相连的本体论世界。
title: Unraveling lithium dreams: Emergent imaginaries and discourses in the Altiplano’s new extractive frontier
title_zh: 揭开锂矿之梦：阿尔蒂普拉诺新采掘前沿中的新兴想象与话语
